errors.evidence: This section completely fails to describe the grouped nature of the chart. It lists values from different metric groups (Recall, F1 Score) without any context, making the description incoherent and factually incorrect. For example, it lists 63.58 (from the 'Recall' group for DIN-SQL zero-shot) and 81.08 (from the 'F1 Score' group for DIN-SQL few-shot) as if they were comparable individual bars rather than parts of distinct groups.

The description fails to identify and describe the key structural feature of the chart: that it is a grouped bar chart. It does not explain that the bars are organized into three groups based on the metrics on the x-axis.
The visible range of the y-axis is from 40 to 100. Stating it ranges from 0 is an assumption, not something explicitly shown.
